high_level_description: The image features a close-up of a mechanical watch and its intricate internal components displayed on a green cloth. The watch is open, revealing the detailed gears, springs, and other mechanical parts that make up its mechanism. The watch face is visible on the right side, showing a clean, minimalist design with Roman numerals for the hours and a small second hand. The hands of the watch are blue, adding a pop of color against the white background of the dial.
